The one-Action ceiling, Reaction denial and other soft riders do not claim whole-Action hard-control allowance. Actual narrowly scoped defenses can suppress individual components. Each cast/mode retains separate caster, concentration, saves and deadline. Half-Speed records compete against the same pre-control Speed, then existing later systemic multipliers apply. Identical Slow -2 AC and DEX penalties do not add; independent Enchantment and Transmutation casts may supply their distinct surviving riders together. Enchantment access: Bard, Crimson Agent, Mirrorsage, Thief, Wizard, Paladin. Transmutation access: Dragoon, Druid, Mage, Monk, Ranger, Shaman, Tinker. Preserve each exact minimum class level. The accompanying ENCHANTMENT_RANK3_INTEGRATION_PLAYTEST.md supplies the expressly bound timing/component procedure; it grants no extra turn, action, hidden information or source access. Actual class access/repertoire, legal action/components/RP, concentration transitions, Dissonance/Refrain and paid cast/counter order follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. A legal cast pays before hidden eligibility/effect resolution; failure or countering refunds nothing and restores no displaced concentration. V is audible, S needs the ordinary usable hand, and F is the normal class focus. Saves use the actual casting class's spell DC and binary-save rules. Hidden eligibility supplies no free diagnostic. Creature type alone supplies no mental immunity; Charmed-only immunity has only its actual condition scope. No generic upcast, extra action budget or resource generation.
